doc.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016

chapter: Playing with Fame and Kim Parker
title: Charlie Parker's influence and Kim Parker's name
summary: Parker did not directly influence Rydin; Kim initially performed as Kim Ibeko.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Yeah. Did he have a profound effect on you? Charlie Parker himself?

No, not just like the most amazing music you can ever imagine. I never really tried to play that way. And I don’t perform his songs. And in fact Kim never sings Charlie Parker’s songs. And in the start of her career she didn’t even use the name. She called her Kim Ibeko. You know she didn’t want to be associated with — she didn’t want to live under her father’s name. And then of course she changed. It would be stupid not to do that.
